title: Exploration of friction stir welding butted thin sheet NiTi with AA6061, AA2024, and AA7075
authors: Brayden Terry, A. Strauss
abstract: Friction stir welding was investigated as a method for producing dissimilar butt joints of 1-mm-thick NiTi sheet with three aluminum alloys: AA6061-T6, AA2024-T3, and AA7075-T6. Dissimilar welding of these materials could enable structural integration of shape memory alloys with common aerospace aluminum alloys, but differences in thermal and mechanical behavior make joining difficult. Joining NiTi and AA6061 was successful, while NiTi and AA2024 showed mixed results under tested conditions. NiTi and AA7075 did not join under tested conditions. Difficulty in joining AA2024 and AA7075 came from post-weld cracking attributed to residual stresses and thermal strain due to mismatch in coefficients of thermal expansion combined with lower ductility in the higher-strength aluminum alloys. Tensile testing showed that AA6061–NiTi welds retained moderate strength, with an average ultimate tensile strength of 167.8 MPa and a weld efficiency of 57.9% relative to AA6061-T6, while AA2024–NiTi welds showed lower strength and ductility, with an average tensile strength of 120 MPa and a weld efficiency of 27.6%. Fracture behavior suggests that failure was controlled by the ability of the interface to bear load across the joint. Microscopy revealed a region of dispersed NiTi particles in both AA6061 and AA2024 stir zones. Larger particles showed evidence of aluminum diffusion, while smaller particles were enriched in either Ni or Ti, consistent with formation of Ni-Al and Ti-Al intermetallic compounds. No intermetallic layer was observed on the micron scale at the weld interfaces for either AA6061 or AA2024. These results demonstrate that FSW can produce dissimilar Al alloy–NiTi joints, but mechanical performance is variable with alloy selection.

infographic.key_insight: Friction stir welding joined 1-mm NiTi to AA6061-T6, produced mixed results with AA2024-T3, and failed to join AA7075-T6 under tested conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Alloy selection is critical when integrating shape-memory NiTi with aerospace aluminum structures using dissimilar butt joints.

Evaluate joint tensile strength and fracture behavior.
Examine stir-zone particles and weld interfaces by microscopy.

zh-Hans.title: NiTi薄板与AA6061、AA2024和AA7075搅拌摩擦对接焊的探索
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究探索了采用搅拌摩擦焊将1 mm厚NiTi薄板分别与三种铝合金AA6061-T6、AA2024-T3和AA7075-T6制成异种材料对接接头。这些材料的异种焊接可实现形状记忆合金与常用航空航天铝合金的结构集成，但其热学和力学行为的差异使连接面临困难。NiTi与AA6061成功实现了连接，而NiTi与AA2024在所测试条件下的连接结果不一。NiTi与AA7075在所测试条件下未能实现连接。AA2024和AA7075的连接困难源于焊后开裂，这被归因于残余应力、热膨胀系数不匹配引起的热应变，以及较高强度铝合金较低延性的共同作用。拉伸试验表明，AA6061–NiTi焊接接头保持了中等强度，平均极限抗拉强度为167.8 MPa，相对于AA6061-T6的焊接接头效率为57.9%；而AA2024–NiTi焊接接头的强度和延性较低，平均抗拉强度为120 MPa，焊接接头效率为27.6%。断裂行为表明，失效受界面跨接头传递载荷的能力控制。显微观察显示，AA6061和AA2024的搅拌区内均存在NiTi颗粒弥散分布的区域。较大颗粒显示出铝扩散的迹象，而较小颗粒则富集Ni或Ti，这与Ni-Al和Ti-Al金属间化合物的形成相一致。在AA6061和AA2024的焊接界面处，均未在微米尺度上观察到金属间化合物层。这些结果表明，搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）能够制备铝合金–NiTi异种材料接头，但其力学性能随合金选择而变化。

infographic.key_insight: 在所测试条件下，搅拌摩擦焊成功将1 mm厚NiTi与AA6061-T6连接，与AA2024-T3的连接结果不一，而与AA7075-T6未能实现连接。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 采用异种材料对接接头将形状记忆NiTi与航空航天铝合金结构集成时，合金选择至关重要。
method: 采用搅拌摩擦焊将NiTi薄板分别与三种铝合金连接。
评估接头抗拉强度和断裂行为。
通过显微观察检查搅拌区颗粒和焊接界面。
infographic.evidence_signal: AA6061–NiTi接头的平均极限抗拉强度为167.8 MPa，焊接接头效率为57.9%；相比之下，AA2024–NiTi接头的相应数值为120 MPa和27.6%。
infographic.watch_item: AA2024和AA7075的焊后开裂被归因于残余应力、热膨胀不匹配与合金较低延性的共同作用。

title: Influence of Welding Process Parameters on Mechanical Properties of Coated Fabric Weld Seams
authors: Yingying Zhang, Lingyu Sheng, Shanshan Xu, Jian Zhang, Junhao XU, Chen Xu
abstract: ABSTRACT Weld seams in membrane structures exhibit a significantly higher failure probability than the base material and often act as initiation points for structural damage. Their mechanical properties are strongly influenced by welding process parameters, including temperature, time, and pressure. This work investigated the effects of welding parameters on the mechanical performance of Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC)- and Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE)-coated fabric weld seams through orthogonal experiments, analyzing the failure modes, mechanical characteristics, and microstructural variations of three weld configurations to reveal the failure mechanism and establish a high-accuracy strength prediction model. Joint efficiency is defined as the ratio of the ultimate bearing capacity of welded joints to that of the base material. For PVC-coated fabrics, the lap weld seams reached a joint efficiency of 108.23 %, with 78 % of specimens failing in the base material. The joint efficiency of single-covered and double-covered butt weld seams dropped to a minimum of 78.54 %, attributed to stress concentration and bending effects. For PTFE-coated fabrics, the maximum joint efficiency reached 101.57 %. The error of the established strength prediction model is less than or equal to 5 %. For the optimal parameter combination (380°C/80 s/0.5 MPa), the predicted strength is 6,954.98 N, with an error of only 0.89 % compared to the measured value.

infographic.key_insight: Welding parameters and seam geometry strongly influence coated-fabric joint strength, with peak joint efficiencies of 108.23% for PVC lap seams and 101.57% for PTFE seams.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing temperature, time, pressure, and joint configuration can reduce weld-seam vulnerability in membrane structures.
method: Orthogonal experiments varying welding temperature, time, and pressure.
Failure-mode, mechanical, and microstructural analysis of three weld configurations.
Strength prediction model evaluated against measured joint performance.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports prediction errors ≤5%; at 380°C, 80 s, and 0.5 MPa, predicted strength was 6,954.98 N with 0.89% error, while 78% of PVC lap specimens failed in the base material.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not establish long-term durability or transferability of the optimal parameters across fabric grades and welding equipment.
infographic.paper_title: Influence of Welding Process Parameters on Mechanical Properties of Coated Fabric Weld Seams

zh-Hans.title: 焊接工艺参数对涂层织物焊缝力学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 膜结构中焊缝的失效概率显著高于母材，且往往成为结构损伤的起始点。焊缝的力学性能受到温度、时间和压力等焊接工艺参数的强烈影响。本研究通过正交试验，探究了焊接参数对聚氯乙烯（PVC）和聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）涂层织物焊缝力学性能的影响，分析了三种焊缝构型的失效模式、力学特征和微观结构变化，以揭示失效机理并建立高精度强度预测模型。接头效率定义为焊接接头极限承载力与母材极限承载力之比。对于PVC涂层织物，搭接焊缝的接头效率达到108.23 %，其中78 %的试样在母材处发生破坏。由于应力集中和弯曲效应，单面盖带和双面盖带对接焊缝的接头效率最低降至78.54 %。对于PTFE涂层织物，最高接头效率达到101.57 %。所建立的强度预测模型误差小于或等于5 %。在最优参数组合（380°C/80 s/0.5 MPa）下，预测强度为6,954.98 N，与实测值相比，误差仅为0.89 %。

infographic.key_insight: 焊接参数和焊缝几何形状显著影响涂层织物接头的强度，PVC搭接焊缝和PTFE焊缝的峰值接头效率分别为108.23%和101.57%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化温度、时间、压力和接头构型可降低膜结构中焊缝的易损性。
method: 开展改变焊接温度、时间和压力的正交试验。
对三种焊缝构型进行失效模式、力学性能和微观结构分析。
利用接头性能实测结果评估强度预测模型。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告的预测误差≤5%；在380°C、80 s和0.5 MPa条件下，预测强度为6,954.98 N，误差为0.89%；同时，78%的PVC搭接试样在母材处发生破坏。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要尚未证实长期耐久性，也未证实最优参数对不同织物等级和焊接设备的适用性。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combined computational and neural-network modelling identified an optimal tested HDPE friction stir welding condition of 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports rapid process-window mapping to reduce weld defects and stabilize thermal and axial-force responses in HDPE joining.
method: Simulate temperature, force, material flow and defects using a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian model.
Train two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force data.
Combine model predictions to map defective and defect-free welding conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The experimentally validated models achieved ANN R² values of 0.91–0.99, while 60 °C bottom preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to about 1100 N.
infographic.watch_item: Predictive accuracy beyond the tested process-parameter range is not established; new operating conditions require experimental validation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算建模与机器学习方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被认可为一种有效的热塑性材料连接技术。本研究结合计算建模与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行了全面预测研究，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟不同转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型通过实验数据验证，在孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应的预测方面均表现出良好的一致性。结果表明，底面预热可有效减小温度梯度，并抑制竖直方向的力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值压入力由1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度由未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减小厚度方向的温度梯度，并使轴向力分布更加稳定。同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），以预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，其R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明模型在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的精度和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架能够快速生成工艺图，标示存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在所测试条件中，最优条件为1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C预热；在1000 rpm且不预热时，由于形成隧道状缺陷，焊接性较差。这些发现为制备性能可靠的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计指导，并展示了计算建模与机器学习的融合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，同时支持该工艺在工业应用中的进一步推广。

infographic.key_insight: 计算建模与神经网络建模相结合，确定了所测试HDPE搅拌摩擦焊条件中的最优条件：1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C底部预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架支持快速绘制工艺窗口图，以减少HDPE连接中的焊接缺陷，并使热响应和轴向力响应更加稳定。
method: 采用三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模型模拟温度、力、材料流动和缺陷。
利用实验温度和轴向力数据训练两个多层感知机神经网络。
结合模型预测结果，绘制存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接条件分布图。
infographic.evidence_signal: 模型经实验验证，其中ANN的R²值达到0.91–0.99，而60 °C底部预热使峰值压入力由1600 N降至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 尚未确定模型在所测试工艺参数范围之外的预测精度；新的操作条件需要通过实验验证。

title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE
authors: Satyanarayan Dubey, Shyam Birla, Tribhuwan Kishore Mishra
abstract: Decarburization during HVOF deposition reduces the workability of Tungsten Carbide-12% Cobalt (WC-12Co) coatings. This work examines how CeO2 and La2O3 reinforcements affect HVOF-sprayed WC-12Co coatings' mechanical, tribological, and microstructural characteristics. Compared to the unreinforced coating, microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, abrasive wear, coefficient of friction, and microhardness were assessed. CeO2 or La2O3 decreased porosity and finer grain structure without affecting bond strength. Coatings with 1 wt.% CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced WC-12Co coating, which had an adhesive bond strength of 73.60 ± 5 MPa. Both changed coatings improved structural stability, grain refinement, and densification. Minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m was found in WC-12Co-1La2O3, whereas the lowest coefficient of friction was 0.4 in WC-12Co-1CeO2. An oxide layer from reinforcements enhanced wear resistance. SEM investigation of worn surfaces showed debris, dislodged carbide particles, SiC grains, microcracks, and grooves as the predominant wear processes.

infographic.key_insight: Adding 1 wt.% CeO2 or La2O3 to HVOF-sprayed WC–12Co refined the microstructure, reduced porosity, and improved hardness and wear performance without affecting bond strength.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Rare-earth oxide reinforcement offers a route to denser, wear-resistant WC–12Co coatings while maintaining adhesion.
method: Deposit unreinforced and CeO2- or La2O3-reinforced WC–12Co coatings using HVOF.
Compare microstructure, phases, bond strength, microhardness, abrasive wear, and friction.
Examine worn surfaces using SEM to identify wear mechanisms.
infographic.evidence_signal: At 1 wt.% addition, CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively; La2O3 achieved the minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m), while CeO2 achieved the lowest friction coefficient of 0.4.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or long-term service performance, limiting direct extrapolation to industrial duty cycles.

zh-Hans.title: CeO2和La2O3增强相对超音速火焰喷涂技术制备的WC–12Co涂层力学、摩擦学及微观组织性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）沉积过程中的脱碳会降低碳化钨-12%钴（WC-12Co）涂层的加工性能。本研究考察了CeO2和La2O3增强相对HVOF喷涂WC-12Co涂层力学、摩擦学及微观组织特征的影响。以未增强涂层为对照，评估了微观组织、物相组成、结合强度、磨粒磨损、摩擦系数和显微硬度。CeO2或La2O3降低了孔隙率并细化了晶粒，且未影响结合强度。与未增强的WC-12Co涂层相比，添加1 wt.% CeO2和La2O3的涂层显微硬度分别提高了6%和4%；未增强涂层的黏附结合强度为73.60 ± 5 MPa。两种改性涂层的结构稳定性、晶粒细化程度和致密化程度均得到改善。WC-12Co-1La2O3的磨损率最低，为3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m，而WC-12Co-1CeO2的摩擦系数最低，为0.4。增强相形成的氧化物层提高了耐磨性。对磨损表面的扫描电子显微镜（SEM）观察显示，磨屑、脱落的碳化物颗粒、SiC晶粒、微裂纹和沟槽是主要磨损过程的表现。

infographic.key_insight: 向HVOF喷涂的WC–12Co中添加1 wt.% CeO2或La2O3，可细化微观组织、降低孔隙率，并提高硬度和耐磨性能，同时不影响结合强度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 稀土氧化物增强为在保持黏附性能的同时制备更致密、更耐磨的WC–12Co涂层提供了一条途径。
method: 采用HVOF沉积未增强的WC–12Co涂层及CeO2或La2O3增强的WC–12Co涂层。
比较微观组织、物相、结合强度、显微硬度、磨粒磨损和摩擦性能。
使用SEM观察磨损表面，以识别磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: 添加量为1 wt.%时，CeO2和La2O3使显微硬度分别提高了6%和4%；La2O3使磨损率降至最低值3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，而CeO2使摩擦系数降至最低值0.4。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明磨损试验条件或长期服役性能，因此限制了将结果直接外推至工业工况循环的适用性。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.key_insight: D-Gun-sprayed NiCrAlY delivered greater hardness and corrosion resistance on Al 6061-T6, while 80Ni20Cr provided better solid-particle erosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should match the dominant damage mechanism rather than assume one coating offers the best protection against all forms of degradation.
method: Deposited 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 using detonation-gun thermal spraying.
Characterised microstructure, phases, roughness and hardness using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM and nanoindentation.
Evaluated corrosion in 3.5 wt% NaCl, wettability and solid-particle erosion.

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的Al 6061-T6基体上爆炸喷涂80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在Al 6061-T6合金基体上沉积了80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、物相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性及抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与80Ni20Cr相比，NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD在80Ni20Cr中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的CrNi相，在NiCrAlY中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的Al₂NiY相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶粒结构。AFM测量表明，在全部三个样品中，NiCrAlY的表面粗糙度最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY的硬度约为80Ni20Cr的10倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY的硬度为7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），而80Ni20Cr为780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆的Al 6061基体为708.68 MPa。在3.5 wt% NaCl溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY的腐蚀电流密度最低，为6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr涂层的腐蚀电流密度为1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY具有超疏水行为，80Ni20Cr具有接近超疏水的行为。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的3.5 wt% NaCl溶液；冲击角度为90°、速度为40 m/s、持续时间为5 min的单一冲蚀工况），NiCrAlY表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而80Ni20Cr表现出更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

title: Lean maintenance 4.0: Enhancing welding machine reliability in steel galvanizing processes
authors: Lucas Matos, Nuno Torre Torre, Andrei Bonamigo
abstract: Maintenance is a critical function in the steel industry, playing a key role in production performance. Lean methodologies are extensively implemented in industrial settings, emphasizing practices that drive continuous improvement. Industry 4.0 has emerged through intelligent technologies designed to digitalize industrial processes. The combination of these approaches creates meaningful synergies that can assist both researchers and practitioners in enhancing the operational efficiency of organizational assets. The objective of this study is to investigate how Lean 4.0 principles can enhance maintenance management and operational efficiency in a welding machine within a steel galvanizing process. This research applies Lean 4.0 principles through an empirical case study of a welding machine in a steel galvanizing line, focusing on ensuring welding quality and optimizing maintenance processes. The findings reveal a considerable reduction in production downtime: by standardizing disc replacement procedures, introducing a machine checklist, and providing staff training, the continuous galvanizing line achieved a reduction of 375 minutes per year in total welding machine downtime, compared to the historical baseline of 496 minutes per year specifically associated with welding disk failures. This optimization resulted in organizational improvements and a more competitive industrial environment with skilled personnel.
venue: International Journal of Industrial Engineering and Management

infographic.engineering_relevance: Standardized maintenance and operator training can improve welding-machine reliability and support production continuity in steel galvanizing.

zh-Hans.title: 精益维护4.0：提升钢铁镀锌工艺中的焊机可靠性
zh-Hans.abstract: 维护是钢铁行业的一项关键职能，对生产绩效起着重要作用。精益方法在工业环境中得到广泛应用，强调推动持续改进的实践。工业4.0随着旨在实现工业流程数字化的智能技术而兴起。这些方法的结合产生了重要的协同效应，可帮助研究人员和实践人员提高组织资产的运行效率。本研究旨在探讨精益4.0原则如何提升钢铁镀锌工艺中焊机的维护管理水平和运行效率。本研究通过对钢铁镀锌线上一台焊机开展实证案例研究，应用精益4.0原则，重点关注确保焊接质量和优化维护流程。研究结果表明，生产停机时间显著减少：通过标准化焊盘更换程序、引入设备检查清单并开展员工培训，连续镀锌线的焊机总停机时间每年减少了375分钟，而专门由焊盘故障导致的历史停机时间基准为每年496分钟。这一优化带来了组织层面的改进，并形成了拥有熟练人员、竞争力更强的工业环境。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting HVAF can improve protection of 304 stainless steel components exposed to combined sliding wear and corrosion.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速氧燃料喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性和耐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层，并系统研究和比较了其微观组织、摩擦学性能和耐蚀性。结果表明，APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更佳。耐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 V_SCE)、最小的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层的耐蚀性在这四种涂层中最差。

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

zh-Hans.title: 用于搅拌摩擦焊7N01铝合金抗拉强度预测与焊接工艺窗口优化的可解释集成学习
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在高精度预测搅拌摩擦焊A7N01P-T4铝合金接头的极限抗拉强度（UTS），阐明焊接参数对UTS的影响，并优化焊接工艺窗口。以旋转速度、焊接速度和轴肩压入深度为输入变量，以UTS为输出变量。利用27个实验样本建立机器学习模型，并通过留一交叉验证进行评估。通过比较决策树、K近邻和高斯过程回归模型，确定决策树为最佳基线模型，其R²为0.905。随后引入集成学习策略构建梯度提升决策树，将R²提高至0.966，并通过网格搜索优化其关键超参数，将R²进一步提高至0.978。SHapley Additive exPlanations分析表明，焊接参数的重要性由高到低依次为焊接速度、旋转速度和轴肩压入深度，所识别的参数影响与实验结果及观察到的微观组织演变具有良好的一致性。优化后的模型预测了接头效率至少达到90%时所有焊接参数的完全可行范围，而轴肩压入深度是进一步细化高强度焊接工艺窗口的关键参数。这些结果表明，所提出的方法不仅提高了UTS预测精度，还揭示了焊接参数的影响，并实现了焊接工艺窗口的优化，为FSW参数选择提供了定量依据。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni–20Cr+40TiC reduced oxidation weight gain by 95.71% relative to bare SA516 boiler steel.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The coating offers a promising route to improve the high-temperature oxidation resistance of SA516 boiler components.

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢表面HVOF及等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的微观组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用高速氧燃料（HVOF）喷涂和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，在SA516锅炉钢表面制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层，并研究其微观组织与高温氧化行为。在模拟实验室环境中，于900°C下进行50次空气循环氧化试验，采用X射线衍射（XRD）、配备能量色散谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）以及X射线元素面分布分析，分析由此产生的微观组织与物相变化。未涂覆的SA516钢氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，并形成不具保护性的物相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，与裸露SA516钢相比，HVOF喷涂Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使最大增重降低了95.71%，表明其具有优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，以及孔隙率降低和显微硬度提高。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 该涂层为提高SA516锅炉部件的高温抗氧化性能提供了一条有前景的途径。

在900°C下进行50次空气循环氧化试验。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power, travel speed, and welding current affect molten-pool flow, weld geometry, and arc stability.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These parameter trends can guide weld optimization for low-thermal-expansion Invar structures used in aerospace composite molds.

High-speed photography of arc characteristics

infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides parameter trends but no quantitative validation errors or mechanical-property results, limiting confidence in extrapolation beyond the studied ranges.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多集中于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演变及电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大会产生更大的反冲压力，促使熔深和小孔尺寸增大，加剧熔池整体流动，且在高功率下电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，速度提高会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，高速下电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大会增强电弧力，促使焊缝宽度增大并加剧熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更加稳定。

title: MULTI-LAYER SELF-LIMITING ELECTROSPRAY DEPOSITION USING VOLTAGE BIAS
authors: Madhuri Deb
abstract: The self-limiting regime of electrospray deposition (SLED) has proven to be a viable alternative to other coating methods, such as dip coating, for complex 3D architectures. This is accomplished by the accumulation of charge in the deposit that reshapes the driving electric field, thus redirecting the spray to uncoated regions of the film. There are, however, drawbacks to this approach. First, SLED coatings, being self-limiting, cannot be applied in multiple layers. Second, the thickness of SLED coatings is determined by the material and spray parameters and tends to be in the range of 2-6 µm when fully densified, preventing nanoscale coatings such as those possible by atomic layer deposition (ALD) or spin coating. Our recent manuscript circumvented this latter limitation by applying a secondary bias to the spray target, which serves to both reduce the SLED thickness and also increase the coating uniformity by making the charged droplets more responsive to the driving electric field and less dominated by droplet momentum. This control has the additional implication of being dynamically adjustable—the bias on the target can be decreased either gradually or stepwise during the spray process. Here, we demonstrate that the stepwise removal of bias can, in turn, result in the stepwise increase of the SLED thickness. This should overcome the first limitation by instead allowing for multilayer coatings that fit within the envelope of the SLED thickness. This encompasses many nanoarchitectures currently deposited through complex, multistep spin-coating and liftoff, such as diodes, capacitors, and batteries, provided that appropriate SLED-compatible inks could be formulated to act as the functional layers of these devices at sufficient performance. This said, SLED multilayer devices could be deposited on non-planar surfaces and in much fewer steps than liftoff (i.e., one spray per layer followed by one debinding/annealing step). In this work, we demonstrate, (i) tri-layer polystyrene stacks with bias-controlled thickness, (ii) uniform tri-layer coatings on a complex geometry, (iii) mechanically robust nanocomposite using thermal capillary rise infiltration (CaRI) of electrosprayed bilayer films, and (iv) a working capacitor on a heat sink, providing the concept of multilayer SLED devices on non-planar surfaces.

infographic.key_insight: Stepwise reduction of target voltage bias enables successive self-limiting electrospray layers within the process’s overall thickness envelope.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Bias-controlled multilayer coating could simplify fabrication on complex, non-planar surfaces compared with multistep spin-coating and liftoff.
method: Apply a secondary voltage bias to the spray target to reduce coating thickness and improve uniformity.
Decrease the target bias stepwise to permit additional self-limiting deposition.
Demonstrate tri-layer polystyrene stacks and uniform tri-layer coatings on a complex geometry.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports bias-controlled tri-layer stacks and complex-geometry coatings, but provides no quantitative thickness, uniformity, or device-performance results.
infographic.watch_item: Functional devices require suitable SLED-compatible inks, and multilayer thickness remains constrained by the self-limiting deposition envelope.
infographic.paper_title: MULTI-LAYER SELF-LIMITING ELECTROSPRAY DEPOSITION USING VOLTAGE BIAS

zh-Hans.title: 利用电压偏置的多层自限性电喷雾沉积
zh-Hans.abstract: 对于复杂三维结构，电喷雾沉积的自限性模式（SLED）已被证明可作为浸涂等其他涂覆方法的可行替代方案。这一过程通过沉积层中的电荷积累实现：积累的电荷重塑驱动电场，从而将喷雾重新导向薄膜尚未涂覆的区域。然而，这种方法也存在不足。首先，SLED涂层具有自限性，因此无法进行多层涂覆。其次，SLED涂层的厚度由材料和喷雾参数决定，完全致密化后的厚度通常为2–6 µm，因此无法实现原子层沉积（ALD）或旋涂所能获得的纳米级涂层。我们近期的文稿通过向喷涂靶体施加附加偏置，克服了后一项限制。该偏置使带电液滴对驱动电场的响应更强，并减弱液滴动量的主导作用，从而既减小SLED涂层厚度，又提高涂层均匀性。这种控制方式还意味着可以进行动态调节——在喷涂过程中，可以逐渐或逐级降低靶体上的偏置。在此，我们证明，逐级撤去偏置可使SLED涂层厚度相应地逐级增加。这应能克服第一项限制，使多层涂层能够在SLED的厚度范围内形成。这涵盖了目前通过复杂、多步骤的旋涂和剥离工艺沉积的许多纳米结构，例如二极管、电容器和电池，前提是能够配制出合适的、与SLED兼容的墨水，使其作为这些器件的功能层并达到足够的性能。在此前提下，SLED多层器件可沉积在非平面表面上，且所需步骤远少于剥离工艺（即每层喷涂一次，随后进行一次脱脂/退火处理）。在本工作中，我们展示了：（i）厚度由偏置控制的三层聚苯乙烯叠层；（ii）复杂几何结构上的均匀三层涂层；（iii）通过对电喷雾双层薄膜进行热毛细上升渗透（CaRI）制备的机械性能稳健的纳米复合材料；以及（iv）散热器上可正常工作的电容器，从而展示了在非平面表面上构建多层SLED器件的概念。

infographic.key_insight: 逐级降低靶体电压偏置，可在该工艺的总体厚度范围内依次形成多个自限性电喷雾沉积层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 与多步骤旋涂和剥离工艺相比，偏置控制的多层涂覆有望简化复杂非平面表面上的制造过程。
method: 向喷涂靶体施加附加电压偏置，以减小涂层厚度并提高均匀性。
逐级降低靶体偏置，以允许进一步的自限性沉积。
展示三层聚苯乙烯叠层以及复杂几何结构上的均匀三层涂层。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了偏置控制的三层叠层和复杂几何结构上的涂层，但未提供厚度、均匀性或器件性能的定量结果。
infographic.watch_item: 功能器件需要合适的、与SLED兼容的墨水，且多层结构的厚度仍受自限性沉积厚度范围的约束。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating properties depend on powder morphology and spray method: detonation spraying delivers higher hardness, while HVOF produces a dense, uniform coating with low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting the powder and spray process can improve coating performance for machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.
method: Compared detonation-sprayed and HVOF WC–Co–Cr coatings.
Examined initial powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
Evaluated microhardness and tribological performance.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports average microhardness of 1449 HV for detonation-sprayed coatings and a friction coefficient of Kt = 0.143 for HVOF coatings.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify test conditions, variability, or wear-rate values, limiting assessment of service-specific durability.
infographic.paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING

zh-Hans.title: HVOF与爆炸喷涂制备WC–Co–Cr涂层的组织形成及耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究分析了原始粉末的形貌，并采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散谱（EDS）分析了涂层的微观组织与相组成。结果表明，使用均质、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状组织，且碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆炸喷涂制备的涂层硬度更高（平均显微硬度为1449 HV），而HVOF制备的涂层则具有高致密度、均匀的微观组织和较低的摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。对比分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些发现有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，从而提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于在强烈摩擦和高载荷条件下运行的零件尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr涂层的性能取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法：爆炸喷涂可获得更高的硬度，而HVOF可制备致密、均匀且摩擦系数低的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 选择合适的粉末和喷涂工艺，可改善承受强烈摩擦和高载荷的机械零件的涂层性能。
method: 对比了爆炸喷涂和HVOF制备的WC–Co–Cr涂层。
采用SEM和EDS研究了原始粉末形貌及涂层微观组织。
评估了显微硬度和摩擦学性能。

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

infographic.key_insight: A physics-grounded welding digital twin combines thermal simulation, Gaussian-process surrogates and robotic control to screen in-space joining strategies before experimental testing.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Fast surrogate predictions could support adaptive welding control when robot travel speed changes, helping maintain consistent joint geometry.
method: Finite-volume thermal model includes phase change, effective thermocapillary transport and local pressure; gravity is assessed separately.
Gaussian-process and neural-network surrogates predict weld responses.

infographic.watch_item: Results are simulation-based; thermal-vacuum, reduced-gravity and robotic hardware-in-the-loop tests are needed to assess model fidelity and controller performance.

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理的数字孪生降低用于在轨金属连接的机器人焊接风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 人们对在轨服务、制造与组装的兴趣日益增长，使面向模块化建造和在轨维修的可靠金属连接技术重新受到关注。机器人焊接具有应用前景，但对其在低重力和低压条件下运行特性的认识仍不充分，且接近实际飞行条件的试验有限。英国航天局支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发基于物理的数字孪生，以系统化降低工艺风险。本文评估了一个基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积热焊池模型、高斯过程（GP）与神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。该简化模型包含固液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八项输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界工况中，80 个求解器响应有 74 个落在 GP 的标称 90% 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，包括缩放处理和预测方差计算。在模拟 UR5 沿 L 形焊缝运动的研究中，比例控制器在拐角附近行进速度下降时调整协同调节焊接电源的设定值。有限体积法重新评估发现，全部 12 个闭环工况点以及 12 个开环工况点中的 9 个，均落在示例性的 1.0–3.0 mm 根部侧焊缝宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持使用该框架，在开展实验测试前筛选焊接工况和控制策略。仍需开展热真空试验、有针对性的低重力试验和机器人硬件在环研究，以评估模型与控制器。

infographic.key_insight: 基于物理的焊接数字孪生结合热仿真、高斯过程代理模型和机器人控制，可在实验测试前筛选在轨连接策略。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 快速代理模型预测有望在机器人行进速度变化时支持自适应焊接控制，帮助保持一致的接头几何形状。
method: 有限体积热模型包含相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力；重力单独评估。
高斯过程和神经网络代理模型用于预测焊接响应。

title: Feedstock Morphology Governs Impact-Induced Deformation in Cold Sprayed Metal-Ceramic Composites
authors: Romario A. Wicaksono, Amir Ardeshiri Lordejani, Sara Bagherifard
abstract: The mechanistic understanding of cold spray additive manufacturing for metal-ceramic composites has mainly focused on spray parameters, whereas the role of metallic feedstock morphology remains comparatively underexplored. This study elucidates how spherical and spongy Cu morphologies govern impact-induced deformation, microstructural evolution, and the resulting structure-property relationship in Cu-Al 2 O 3 composite deposits. Multi-scale characterization, including microstructural analysis, nano- and micro-hardness measurements, micro-compression tests, and tribological analyses, reveals distinct strain patterns within the deposits that are influenced by particle morphology. Spherical Cu promotes interfacial strain localization and interfacial metal–ceramic contacts along flattened splats, giving rise to a distinct bimodal grain structure characterized by grain refinement at splat boundaries and larger, unrefined grains within splat cores. This microstructural gradient effectively balances strength and ductility. In contrast, the collapse of the spongy Cu ligament upon impact forms a volumetrically distributed strain-hardened zone, resulting in a more broadly distributed strain accumulation and enhanced ceramic encapsulation. The findings indicate that ceramic particles play an active role in influencing deformation caused by impact, while also passively strengthening the deposits. This dual function is directly reflected in the enhanced performance of the deposits, even at comparable reinforcement fraction. These findings demonstrate that, in addition to the spray parameters, the powder morphology serves as a fundamental governing factor in controlling the deformation mechanisms and deposit performance.

infographic.key_insight: Cu feedstock morphology governs impact deformation in cold-sprayed Cu–Al₂O₃ composites: spherical particles localize strain at splat interfaces, while spongy particles distribute strain through ligament collapse.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Feedstock morphology offers a design lever alongside spray parameters for tailoring composite coating microstructure and mechanical performance.

zh-Hans.title: 原料形貌主导冷喷涂金属-陶瓷复合材料中的冲击诱导变形
zh-Hans.abstract: 对金属-陶瓷复合材料冷喷涂增材制造的机理认识主要集中于喷涂参数，而对金属原料形貌作用的研究相对不足。本研究阐明了球形和海绵状Cu形貌如何主导Cu-Al₂O₃复合沉积层中的冲击诱导变形、微观组织演变及由此形成的组织-性能关系。包括微观组织分析、纳米及显微硬度测量、微压缩试验和摩擦学分析在内的多尺度表征揭示了沉积层内受颗粒形貌影响的不同应变分布模式。球形Cu促进应变在界面处局部化，并促进沿扁平化颗粒界面形成金属-陶瓷接触，从而产生显著的双峰晶粒组织，其特征是扁平化颗粒边界处晶粒细化，而颗粒核心内部保留较大、未细化的晶粒。这种微观组织梯度有效平衡了强度与延性。相比之下，海绵状Cu的韧带在冲击下塌缩，形成在体积内分布的应变硬化区，使应变积累的空间分布更广，并增强对陶瓷颗粒的包覆。研究结果表明，陶瓷颗粒既主动影响冲击引起的变形，也被动强化沉积层。这种双重作用直接体现为沉积层性能的提升，即使在增强相含量相近时也是如此。这些发现表明，除喷涂参数外，粉末形貌也是控制变形机制和沉积层性能的基础性主导因素。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Dense, fine-lamellar Fe-based amorphous coatings improve long-term corrosion resistance, while increasing humidity reduces friction and wear.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Detonation-spray parameter control can reduce coating defects on Q235 steel, with service humidity also influencing wear performance.
method: Deposit Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 carbon steel using varied detonation-spray parameters.
Examine droplet morphology, coating microstructure, and porosity.
Evaluate long-term corrosion and sliding wear against Si3N4 balls under different humidity conditions.

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为及其在不同湿度环境下的磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成具有致密微观组织的细片层结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷的增多与长期耐腐蚀性能的降低相关。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层在不同湿度条件下的磨损行为具有重要影响。涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度升高而降低。

infographic.key_insight: 致密、细片层结构的铁基非晶涂层可提高长期耐腐蚀性能，而湿度升高可降低摩擦和磨损。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比例（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调节为1.0、1.1和1.2。使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数。对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。随着O₂/C₂H₂比值增大，涂层组织趋于致密，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度则从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa增至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。当O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得了最高的平均显微硬度，为1051.7 HV。在所考察的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的有效手段。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

zh-Hans.title: 采用钻孔—凸台对接几何构型与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 航空航天和汽车行业对轻质高强材料的需求不断增长，使AA2024-T351等铝合金凭借出色的强度重量比受到广泛关注。然而，在此类合金中获得可靠的接头仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究着重优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。受传统榫卯接头启发，本研究引入了一种新型钻孔—凸台对接几何构型，以增强机械互锁并改善焊缝完整性。采用L18正交表系统设计实验，以评估抗拉强度和抗扭强度。实验在一台定制改装的普通车床上进行，并将摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何构型和摩擦时间选为可控工艺参数。同时，采用集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络等先进深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，由30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔—凸台对接几何构型及4 min摩擦时间组成的最优参数组合产生了优异的力学性能，抗拉强度达到538 MPa，抗扭强度达到325 MPa。与传统平面—平面对接接头相比，钻孔—凸台对接构型表现出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在各深度学习模型中，集成残差网络的预测精度最高，R²值约为0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊缝强度之间的复杂关系。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂制备的钛基涂层的表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性能与爆炸喷涂条件之间的关系。研究发现，通过选择特定的喷涂工艺参数值，可以在制备过程中控制表面粗糙度、表层厚度及其疏水性等性能。确定了使所制备涂层疏水性达到最大的爆炸喷涂工艺参数最优值。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度随喷嘴移动速度的变化遵循反幂律。粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离的变化遵循抛物线规律。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，并确定使涂层疏水性达到最佳的最优喷涂工况。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂参数可用于调控二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 所报告的关系可指导喷嘴速度和喷涂距离的选择，以获得目标涂层几何特征并最大限度地提高拒水性。
method: 改变二氧化钛基涂层的爆炸喷涂条件。
评估表面粗糙度、涂层厚度和接触角。
推导预测方程，并确定使疏水性达到最大的条件。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了粗糙度和厚度与喷嘴移动速度之间的反幂律关系，以及粗糙度和接触角与喷涂距离之间的抛物线关系。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供具体的参数范围、接触角数值或预测误差，限制了对性能和可迁移性的评估。

title: Structure and properties of AlB12-Al detonation coatings on steel 45
authors: Oleksandr Umanskyi, В. Б. Муратов, Vladimir E. Shelud'ko, K.N. Haltsov, А. А. Бондаренко, T. V. Mosina
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the properties of detonation coatings AlB 12 -30 wt.% Al (AB70) and AlB 12 -70 wt.% Al (AB30) applied to 45 Steel using the DNEPR-5M installation.The coatings have the following characteristics: thickness h ~ 170-200 μm, H μ = 27-29 GPa, HV = 4.35 GPa.Changes in the tribological characteristics of the composites depending on the friction mode are analyzed.The AB70 composition was found to have stable tribological characteristics: f = 0.21-0.38,wear rate I = 3.3-8.6μm/km.Coated samples outperform uncoated 45 steel in wear resistance.Changes in the surface structure after friction are shown depending on the sliding speed and load.Two wear mechanisms have been identified: oxidative and adhesive-abrasive.It was concluded that it is possible to use the AlB 12 -Al system for applying detonation coatings.Keywords: AlB 12 -Al, detonation coatings, microstructure, hardness, tribological characteristics Структура та властивості детонаційних покриттів системи AlB 12 -Al.О.П.Уманський, В.Б.Муратов, В.Є.Шелудько, К.М.Гальцов, О.А.Бондаренко, Т.В.Мосіна, В.Л.Сироватка, І.С.Марценюк, В.Т.Варченко, В.В.Кременицький, А.В.Міницький, О.В.Кущев.Статтю присвячено дослідженню властивостей детонаційних покриттів AlB 12 -30 мас.%Al (AB70) та AlB 12 -70 мас.%Al (AB30), нанесених на Сталь 45 на установці "ДНІПРО-5М".Покриття мають такі характеристики: товщина h ~ 170-200 мкм, H μ = 27-29 ГПа, HV = 3.67-4.35ГПа.Проаналізовано зміну трибологічних характеристик композитів в залежності від режиму тертя.Встановлено, що покриття АВ70 має стабільніші трибологічні характеристики: f = 0.21-0.38,інтенсивність зношування I = 3.3-8.6мкм/км.Зразки з покриттями перевищують сталь 45 без покриття за зносостійкістю.Показано зміну структури поверхні після тертя в залежності від швидкості ковзання та навантаження.Встановлено прояв двох механізмів зношування -оксидного та адгезійно-абразивного.Зроблено висновок щодо можливості застосування системи AlB 12 -Al для нанесення детонаційних покриттів.

infographic.key_insight: AlB₁₂–Al detonation coatings improved the wear resistance of steel 45, with AB70 showing stable friction and wear behavior across the tested conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These coatings offer a potential wear-protection option for steel components exposed to sliding contact.
method: Deposited AB70 (70 wt.% AlB₁₂, 30 wt.% Al) and AB30 (30 wt.% AlB₁₂, 70 wt.% Al) using a DNEPR-5M detonation-spray system.
Characterized coating thickness, hardness, and surface structure.
Evaluated friction and wear under varying sliding speeds and loads.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports coating thicknesses of approximately 170–200 μm, AB70 friction coefficients of 0.21–0.38, and AB70 wear rates of 3.3–8.6 μm/km, with coated samples outperforming uncoated steel 45 in wear resistance.
infographic.watch_item: Oxidative and adhesive-abrasive wear depended on sliding conditions, but the abstract does not specify the tested speed and load ranges needed to judge application suitability.
infographic.paper_title: Structure and properties of AlB12-Al detonation coatings on steel 45

zh-Hans.title: 45钢上AlB12-Al爆炸喷涂涂层的组织与性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文研究了采用DNEPR-5M装置在45钢上制备的AlB12-30 wt.% Al（AB70）和AlB12-70 wt.% Al（AB30）爆炸喷涂涂层的性能。涂层具有以下特征：厚度h ~ 170-200 μm，Hμ = 27-29 GPa，HV = 4.35 GPa。分析了复合材料的摩擦学性能随摩擦工况的变化。研究发现，AB70组分具有稳定的摩擦学性能：f = 0.21-0.38，磨损率I = 3.3-8.6 μm/km。涂层试样的耐磨性优于未涂覆的45钢。展示了不同滑动速度和载荷下摩擦后表面组织的变化。确定了两种磨损机制：氧化磨损和黏着-磨粒磨损。研究得出结论，AlB12-Al体系可用于制备爆炸喷涂涂层。关键词：AlB12-Al，爆炸喷涂涂层，显微组织，硬度，摩擦学性能。AlB12-Al体系爆炸喷涂涂层的组织与性能。О.П.Уманський、В.Б.Муратов、В.Є.Шелудько、К.М.Гальцов、О.А.Бондаренко、Т.В.Мосіна、В.Л.Сироватка、І.С.Марценюк、В.Т.Варченко、В.В.Кременицький、А.В.Міницький、О.В.Кущев。本文研究了采用“ДНІПРО-5М”装置在45钢上制备的AlB12-30 wt.% Al（AB70）和AlB12-70 wt.% Al（AB30）爆炸喷涂涂层的性能。涂层具有以下特征：厚度h ~ 170-200 μm，Hμ = 27-29 GPa，HV = 3.67-4.35 GPa。分析了复合材料的摩擦学性能随摩擦工况的变化。研究发现，AB70涂层具有更稳定的摩擦学性能：f = 0.21-0.38，磨损率I = 3.3-8.6 μm/km。涂层试样的耐磨性优于未涂覆的45钢。展示了不同滑动速度和载荷下摩擦后表面组织的变化。确定了两种磨损机制的存在：氧化磨损和黏着-磨粒磨损。研究得出结论，AlB12-Al体系可用于制备爆炸喷涂涂层。

infographic.key_insight: AlB₁₂–Al爆炸喷涂涂层提高了45钢的耐磨性，其中AB70在所测试的各工况下表现出稳定的摩擦与磨损行为。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些涂层为承受滑动接触的钢制部件提供了一种潜在的耐磨防护方案。
method: 采用DNEPR-5M爆炸喷涂系统沉积AB70（70 wt.% AlB₁₂，30 wt.% Al）和AB30（30 wt.% AlB₁₂，70 wt.% Al）涂层。
表征涂层的厚度、硬度和表面组织。
评估不同滑动速度和载荷下的摩擦与磨损性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告的涂层厚度约为170–200 μm，AB70的摩擦系数为0.21–0.38，磨损率为3.3–8.6 μm/km，且涂层试样的耐磨性优于未涂覆的45钢。
infographic.watch_item: 氧化磨损和黏着-磨粒磨损取决于滑动工况，但摘要未说明用于判断应用适用性所需的测试速度和载荷范围。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: UNSM-treated Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings showed sample-dependent hardness, with peak values at 20 N/20 µm for detonation-sprayed coatings and 30 N/30 µm for HVOF coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: UNSM parameter selection should consider both local hardness and surface integrity rather than assume a uniform benefit across deposition routes.
method: Evaluated four UNSM-treated samples per deposition route using static loads of 20–30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20–30 µm.
Measured instrumental hardness at 300 mN with a 10 s dwell.
Examined post-scratch surfaces by SEM.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness ranged from 820–970 HV for detonation-sprayed coatings and 546–1165 HV for HVOF coatings; post-scratch SEM showed heterogeneous contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both series.
infographic.watch_item: Post-scratch images do not isolate UNSM-induced damage or establish a scratch-resistance ranking.
infographic.paper_title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 研究了爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）制备的Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）后的硬度与划痕后表面形貌。针对每种沉积工艺，采用20和30 N的静载荷以及20和30 µm的振动振幅，对四个处理样品进行了评估。在300 mN载荷、10 s保载时间下测量了仪器化硬度。DS样品的硬度为820–970 HV，而HVOF样品的硬度范围更宽，为546–1165 HV。DS-T1在20 N/20 µm条件下、HVOF-T4在30 N/30 µm条件下分别获得了各自系列的最高硬度值。划痕试验后获取的扫描电子显微镜（SEM）视场图像显示，两个涂层系列均存在不均匀的表面衬度和裂纹状不连续区域。这些观察结果为试验后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但无法单独识别由UNSM造成的损伤，也无法确定耐划痕性能的排序。作为补充观察结果，报告了六个处理样品的可用平均摩擦系数。结果表明，硬度响应因样品而异，并强调了结合表面完整性评估局部力学性能的必要性。

infographic.key_insight: 经UNSM处理的Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层表现出因样品而异的硬度；爆炸喷涂涂层和HVOF涂层的硬度峰值分别出现在20 N/20 µm和30 N/30 µm条件下。
infographic.engineering_relevance: UNSM参数选择应同时考虑局部硬度和表面完整性，而不应假定其对不同沉积工艺均具有一致的改善效果。
method: 采用20–30 N的静载荷和20–30 µm的振动振幅，评估每种沉积工艺对应的四个UNSM处理样品。
在300 mN载荷、10 s保载时间下测量仪器化硬度。
利用SEM观察划痕后的表面。
infographic.evidence_signal: 爆炸喷涂涂层的硬度范围为820–970 HV，HVOF涂层为546–1165 HV；划痕后的SEM图像显示，两个系列均存在不均匀衬度和裂纹状不连续区域。
infographic.watch_item: 划痕后图像无法单独识别UNSM引起的损伤，也无法确定耐划痕性能的排序。
